test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 24th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c2fa0181efd29f32a28866abd733742b490ac2b53b8f6e82eb3d38a6c000a843.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 
• # symbol is rotated 45⁰ clockwise from figure to figure.
 
• Figure 1 to figure 2 inner square vertices are connected with outer square vertices.
 
• Figure 2 to figure 3 inner square vertices are connected with outer square vertices,
 
• Figure 3 to figure 4 inner square vertices has to be connected with outer square vertices.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2ca078efb598db403fddf4a7508726bcf152308e276c8c5668fd95ac6f28acbd.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3"
